It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}}. Its {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|lt=former shrine rank}} was {{ill|Son-sha|Q134917284|qid=Q134917284}}. {{nihongo|'''Toba Shrine'''|等波神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Ōmi Province]].

== Enshrined deities ==
It has {{ill|Ame-no-torifune|Q10731425|qid=Q10731425|lt=Toriiwa Kusunokifune-no-Mikoto}} as its principal deity, with {{ill|Emperor Chūai|Q179971|qid=Q179971}} and {{ill|Empress Jingū|Q232803|qid=Q232803}} as associated deities.

== History ==
Tradition says it was founded in {{ill|684|Q31128|qid=Q31128}} (Hakuhō 13). It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Engishiki shrine|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}. In October {{ill|1876|Q7766|qid=Q7766}} (Meiji 9), it was ranked as a {{ill|Son-sha|Q134917284|qid=Q134917284}}, and in {{ill|1909|Q2057|qid=Q2057}} (Meiji 42) it was designated as a {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Shinsen Heihaku-ryō Kyōshinsha}}.

* Double tomoe

== Festivals ==
* Okonai: February 8-9
* Annual festival: April 9
